verdict.rationale: Meta's first-party safety blog says trajectories are used for training by default after PII sanitization. It also says users who don't want their data used in model training at all can opt out via a simple switch in Muse settings, which directly delivers the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the switch works, detail on the opt-out's scope (e.g., whether it applies retroactively or covers connected-app data), and that training use is opt-out rather than off by default.
